status: Specified from the accepted art direction; shared components and new screens remain subject to visual review.
approval: 2026-10-16: user approved the overall Batch 1 direction and authorized continuing, with an explicit requirement for consistent coins and menus.

coin.silhouette: One round gold pixel coin with a stepped rim, amber right edge, upper-left glint and a simple vertical inset. No letter, paw, gem, star or alternative currency emblem.
coin.badge: Cream inset, wood frame, navy numerals; icon left, number right. Same component at home, on the map, in the shop, in the adventure and results.
coin.meaning: Wallet coins outside an adventure. Run coins in the adventure carry a visible Run coins label. Completion breakdown uses the same coin asset.

type.family: One rounded sans family; use the engine default throughout the prototype until a licensed production family is selected.
type.numerals: Same upright navy numerals in every counter; avoid decorative pixel text at unreadable sizes.

panels: Cream surfaces, dark warm wood outlines and restrained lighter wood edges. Consistent corner treatment and spacing. Do not switch counters or menus to unrelated blue metal or dark glass frames.

buttons.default: Cream face, wood outline, navy label and consistent icon alignment.
buttons.primary: Gold face, same wood outline and navy label; one primary action per panel.
buttons.selected: Gold fill plus selected marker; never color alone.
buttons.focus: Visible blue outer focus ring, independent of selected state.
buttons.pressed: Deeper gold/cream face and inset edge; same geometry.
buttons.disabled: Desaturated cream, readable label, visible lock/reason when relevant.

icons.settings: White gear in a blue square

navigation: Shared home/menu header: Back/title left, contextual navigation middle, wallet counter and settings right. Adventure: hearts/goal left, run coins and pause right; movement and action controls in lower corners. Do not put gameplay goals over the landing area.
character: Reuse V01 explorer and Foxy identity, palette, stage proportions and equipment. Room close-ups can be larger; they cannot redesign faces or clothing.
logo: Use the second user-supplied reference's chunky multicolor PETOPIA, paw O and wood/leaf treatment. No floating heart or heart-shaped I dot. Large only on the title screen; other screens use a compact title.
accessibility: At least 48 logical pixel hit targets, visible keyboard focus, text/icon state cues, short labels, no sound-only or color-only essential information.
production: Generated screens illustrate this system. Actual UI must reuse shared textures and components instead of importing a different baked-in control from each picture. Production texture import uses nearest filtering and consistent integer scales.

responsive_layout.primary: Portrait mobile, 390 logical px reference width; desktop keyboard testing retained.
responsive_layout.targets: 52/60/68 px touch buttons (default60); minimum48 at360px display width. Menu buttons56px and body18px.
responsive_layout.safe_area: 12px minimum inset plus Android/iOS reported display-safe area.
responsive_layout.world: Independent nearest-filtered SubViewport; 360 world-px height and aspect-aware adventure camera. Menus never stretch a landscape UI into portrait.
responsive_layout.controls: Left movement, right jump/use/Foxy; independent pointers; Pause → Touch controls saves size, spacing0/12/24 and raise0/16/32. Safe bounded presets rather than drag-only editing.
responsive_layout.home: Room preview above scrollable care; four needs in two-column summary, all five needs plus bond in details.
responsive_layout.status: Implemented prototype; physical-device and child-playtest gate remains open.

menu_button_override.face: Cream inset and simple wooden frame from second attachment; all illustrated menu actions including primary/Done.
menu_button_override.states: A33 supersedes A31 only for interaction states: cream rest, gold focus/selection/hover, blue keyboard focus outline; disabled cream/gray plus lock. Small icon lift/press motion, suppressed by reduced motion.

menu_fidelity_revision.buttons: Desktop352x104; phone282x72/76; smaller text/icons with measured fit and native hitboxes unchanged.
menu_fidelity_revision.icons: Pixel-art play/paw/map/lock/gear from user close-up; stepped clusters, nearest sampling, compact silhouettes.
menu_fidelity_revision.wallet: Detailed wood/cream frame, canonical coin plus real native balance, no illustrative85.
menu_fidelity_revision.settings: Blue gear tile inside compact wood/cream button at lower-right.
menu_fidelity_revision.animation: Four-pose calm petting loop and fixed sparse pixel contact shadow; respects saved reduced motion.
